verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents itself as running real engines (Vitess/MySQL, Postgres, Neki) with imports, branching, and standard SQL shells (planetscale-docs-13, docs-17, docs-24, docs-37), suggesting full engine fidelity. But independent community reports concretely contradict this for MySQL/Vitess: foreign keys — a core MySQL feature many existing apps rely on — are not supported, a limitation explicitly called out as breaking compatibility for 'existing apps that use an RDBMS you want to scale' (planetscale-comm-7, comm-8, comm-10), and schema-change workflows don't support FKs at all. This is a documented gap between marketed compatibility and hands-on reality, not merely subjective skepticism. missing for 10: confirmation that Postgres/Neki offerings have no comparable extension/dialect gaps, and resolution or acknowledgment of the FK limitation in vendor docs.
